title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
At the Federal Home Loan Bank of Chicago, employees come first - that’s why we offer a highly competitive compensation and bonus package, and access to a comprehensive benefits program designed to meet the needs of our employees.

  • Collaborative, in-office operating model

  • Retirement program (401k and Pension)

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • Lifestyle Spending Account

  • Competitive PTO plan

  • 11 paid holidays per year

      ​

      What you'll do

      Our Lead Quality Engineer is responsible for advancing the Bank’s quality engineering capabilities by shifting from traditional test execution toward an automation-first, engineering-led quality model driving built-in quality end to end. This role combines hands-on technical delivery like an experienced SDET with team leadership, quality governance and mentoring across agile delivery teams. The role designs, develops, and maintains End to End Test Plans, scalable automated test frameworks; integrates continuous testing into CI/CD pipelines; and partners with developers, product owners, business analysts, security, architecture, operations, and risk stakeholders to ensure quality is built into every phase of the SDLC.

      The position helps enable the Bank’s modern engineering transformation through test automation, Performance testing, test environment, test data and DevSecOps practices. Enables AI-assisted delivery, secure pipeline controls, DORA-aligned metrics, and quality ownership across product teams. This role is expected to be both hands-on manual, automation and supervisory: directly contributing to Test plans, automation frameworks, test strategy, code review, CI/CD quality gates, and technical problem-solving, while also coaching Quality Engineers / SDETs, influencing standards, and helping product teams adopt modern quality practices.

      How you'll make an impact:

      • Elevate Summit quality and release confidence by designing and executing robust manual and automated test strategies for Summit and its complex integrations—ensuring stable, scalable, and defect-resistant releases.

      • Accelerate delivery through automation and data excellence by strengthening Selenium/Playwright and API automation frameworks while implementing reliable test data creation, masking, and refresh strategies across multi-org Summit environments. In addition to using industry standard test automation tools, the candidate will be expected to learn and use the Test Management System (TMS), a Summit proprietary test automation tool.

      • Reduce production risk and defects by validating accounting data, payment flows, end-to-end workflows, integrations, and data integrity using SQL and API testing, while proactively identifying issues early in the Agile lifecycle.

      • Strengthen QA maturity and team capability by mentoring junior QA engineers, driving best practices in quality engineering, and continuously improving QA processes, standards, and reporting through Azure DevOps.

      What you can expect:

      • Lead the Quality Engineering strategy cross-team and end to end, Test Management for all test engineering approaches (Functional, Regression, SIT, E2E, UAT,Perfornance/Load, Test Data, Test Environment), test automation architecture, Exploratory and continuous testing practices across agile product teams, ensuring quality is built into every stage of the SDLC.

      • Architect, Design, develop, and maintain scalable Test plans and automated test frameworks and reusable quality engineering solutions supporting functional, API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and non-functional testing.

      • Define and implement quality engineering strategies and best practices across agile teams, including system architecture review, test pyramid alignment, risk-based automation, test data strategy, environment readiness, traceability, and release quality criteria.

      • Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to drive shared ownership of quality, defect prevention,testability, non-functional requirements and production readiness.

      • Build, Integrate and maintain automated tests using strong coding practices, quality gates, reusable libraries, page/object models, service-level test patterns, test data utilities, and CI/CD-ready execution models to enable rapid, reliable, and secure software delivery. Support DevSecOps transformation by embedding security and quality controls into the SDLC.

      • Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, business analysts, security, infrastructure, operations, and risk/compliance stakeholders to validate requirements, acceptance criteria, design quality, and production readiness.

      • Review user stories, acceptance criteria, architecture designs, API contracts, data flows, and technical specifications to identify test scenarios. risks, improve testability, and prevent defects earlier in the lifecycle.

      • Establish, Measure/Monitor and communicate quality metrics such as automation coverage, escaped defects, defect trends, test effectiveness, pipeline quality gate results, deployment readiness, and DORA-aligned delivery outcomes.

      • Review user stories, acceptance criteria, architecture designs, API contracts, data flows, and technical specifications to identify risks, improve testability, and prevent defects earlier in the lifecycle. Lead root-cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives, driving systemic solutions that reduce risk, improve reliability, and strengthen engineering outcomes.

      • Support audit readiness and regulatory expectations by ensuring quality processes produce traceable evidence, controlled approvals, policy-aligned gates, and measurable risk reduction.

      • Mentor, coach, provide supervisory support and technical leadership to Quality Engineers, SDETs, and other engineering team members while supporting talent development, performance, prioritization, and delivery execution.

      • Champion & Promote modern engineering capabilities including AI-assisted testing, GitHub Copilot adoption, reusable automation assets, human-in-the-loop quality controls and enterprise quality engineering transformation initiatives.

      What you’ll bring:

      • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.

      • 10+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test planning, Software Development Engineering in Test (SDET), Test Automation, Software Engineering, Test Management end to end or related technology disciplines.

      • 5+ years of experience mentoring, coaching, or supervisory oversight to Quality Engineers, SDETs, or software delivery teams.

      • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-scale automated test frameworks and quality engineering solutions for API/Web/ERP/Mobile/CRM/Salesforce/SaaS/Summit/Data/EDW/Batch processes/Financial systems or Similar.

      • Strong hands-on programming experience using object-oriented languages such as C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or equivalent.

      • Experience with modern test automation frameworks including Playwright, Selenium, Appium, SpecFlow/Cucumber, API automation frameworks, BDD and service virtualization tools.

      • Experience integrating automated testing and quality controls into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar technologies.

      • Strong experience testing APIs, web applications, cloud-native solutions, databases, and integrated enterprise platforms.

      • Experience with performance/load test, test environment/data TDEM management, security, and non-functional testing practices.

      • Experience with source control, code review, branching strategies, and modern engineering workflows using GitHub and/or Azure DevOps.

      • Working knowledge of relational databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or similar technologies.

      • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or comparable environments, microservices and Event based architectures, domain model understanding.

      • Familiarity with DevSecOps tooling and practices, including code quality, security scanning, software supply chain controls, and automated quality gates.

      • Professional certifications such as ISTQB, CSTE, CSQA, Certified Agile Tester, AWS, Azure, or equivalent certifications are a plus.

      • Experience within a banking, financial services, or other regulated industry is preferred.

      • Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute work effectively in a fast-paced delivery environment.

      • Knowledge of banking, financial services, audit, regulatory, and risk-control expectations is preferred.

      • Demonstrated leadership, project management, mentoring, coaching, problem-solving and team enablement capabilities.

      Expert/Advanced Competencies-

      • Quality Engineering Strategy / KPIs / DORA

      • Test Strategy Development & Test Planning

      • Test Management in ADO

      • Functional Testing, API Testing, System Integration Testing / SIT

      • End-to-End Testing, UAT / Business Validation Support

      • Test Automation of Functional, Regression, Integration, E2E

      • Regression Test Automation Optimization & Integrated in pipelines

      • Test Framework development & Maintenance / Harness Development

      • Test Data Management, Test Environment Readiness & Validation, TDEM

      • Ephemeral Test Environments / IaC, Cloud Fundamentals / Containers

      • Service Mocking / Service Virtualization, SQL & Backend Data Validation

      • CI/CD Pipeline Testing & Quality Gates

      • Release Management / Deployment Readiness

      • Performance, Load & Reliability Testing

      • Software Monitoring / Event Management / Operational Validation

      • Incident / Problem Management / RCA

      • Defect Management, Defect Prevention & Detection

      • Shift-Left / Shift-Right Testing

      • Agile / Secure SDLC Practices

      • DevOps / DevSecOps Practices, TDD / BDD

      • Architecture & Technical Specifications Review

Job Description

Overview

CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index and the NASDAQ 100, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

Our CoStar for Debt Solutions product development team

We are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer to own the architecture and design of our software systems, from full stack web products to high-volume, secure data pipelines. This role includes design of new greenfield systems, so being able to convert product requirements to system architecture is essential. It will also help guide the ongoing architectural evolution of our current solutions, meaning the ability to fully understand existing complex systems is required as well.

It is a highly collaborative role that comes with great influence on the technical solutions we are building and requires strong communication and cooperation across multiple teams and disciplines. This includes developers within the same team and Software Architects throughout the company. To be successful in this role you must be a problem‑solving, collaborative person with deep technical skills, and the ability to work in a secure, performant, enterprise‑scale environment.

This position will be located in San Diego (UTC Area) and is in office Monday through Thursday and work from home on Friday.

Responsibilities

  • Work in partnership with Product and Technology leadership to deeply understand a project’s complex functional requirements and drive implementation of appropriate technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with development teams to determine the right architectural direction based on project needs, level of effort, resourcing, timing, etc.
  • Understand existing systems and ensure they are well documented, so that you become a go‑to source of architectural information across multiple systems.
  • Act as an architectural subject matter expert and source of good advice to technical leadership and developers.
  • Drive and evangelize architectural principles and guidelines to ensure high quality, consistent results across teams.
  • Partner with engineering managers to ensure that they are following established architectural best practices.
  • Create, organize, and maintain architectural diagrams and other system documentation.
  • Provide architectural guidance and mentoring to other technical staff on topics such as microservices, micro‑frontends, high‑volume data streaming / event processing, etc.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies, evaluate and development practices and identify how they might improve existing or new systems we are building.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the CoStar business, and how the technical work we are doing aligns with that strategy.
  • Advocate for and design solutions that are well‑instrumented, so that we are confident we are building stable, high‑performance products.
  • Be a go‑to resource in the understanding and diagnosis of complex performance, scalability, and reliability issues.
  • Be an advocate for security and ensure that we are architecting and building secure software products and platforms.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required from an accredited, not‑for‑profit, in‑person college/university.
  • A track record of commitment to prior employers.
  • 10+ years of hands‑on experience in designing highly complex enterprise‑level web applications, including deep knowledge of microservices, serverless, data, and web applications.
  • Experience designing and building secure systems and security‑minded development practices. Experience with financial data is a big plus.
  • Extensive experience in software engineering with expert‑level proficiency in at least one of these programming languages: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript. Exposure to languages and platforms across the full web application stack is a big plus (e.g., GraphQL).
  • Significant, hands‑on experience designing and implementing solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS) services including Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, SNS/SQS, S3, API Gateway, etc.
  • Experience with Test Driven Development methodologies.
  • Experience modeling and implementing large‑scale relational and NoSQL database systems.
  • Experience designing/implementing event‑oriented architectures and real‑time data streaming solutions.
  • Strong ability to communicate through architectural diagrams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Architect‑level certifications from AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Experience with modern source control and CI/CD technologies including Git or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience establishing software development best practices, including standards, code reviews, source control, builds, testing and operations.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code in Terraform.
  • Experience in observability logging/tracing with CloudWatch and/or Kibana.
  • Experience building highly secure software, including tokenization, OpenID, etc.
  • Team or project leadership experience is a plus.

What’s in it for You

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
Administrative Coordinator
Location: Raleigh, NC.
Position Type: Full-time

Are you a highly organized, tenacious, and detail-oriented professional who takes pride in creating seamless office experiences?
New Leaf Behavioral Health is a non-profit organization dedicated to providing affordable, accessible, and high-quality mental health care to our community. We are seeking a dedicated Administrative Coordinator to anchor our late afternoon and evening operations, ensuring our clinic runs efficiently and our clients receive exceptional care from the moment they reach out to us.

Hours:
  • Monday – Friday: 7:45 am - 4:45 pm

Who You Are:
We are looking for more than just a receptionist; we are seeking a proactive professional who embodies the following core characteristics:
  • A Champion of Order: You thrive on maintaining a highly functional and welcoming office environment. You naturally anticipate needs, keep systems organized, and ensure smooth handoffs between daytime and evening operations.
  • Relentlessly Tenacious & Detailed: You possess an unwavering commitment to accuracy. Whether you are performing data entry, bookkeeping, or proofreading documents, you have a meticulous eye for detail and take pride in getting things right the first time.
  • Proactive Problem Solver: You maintain a polished, professional demeanor and a positive attitude, even when troubleshooting unexpected issues. You navigate challenges with tact, diplomacy, and a great sense of humor.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You coordinate seamlessly with directors, clinicians, and other office staff to support organizational goals, willing to jump into different roles—with a smile—whenever required.

Key Responsibilities:
Operational & Administrative Support:
  • Follow and uphold office protocols, policies, and procedures to ensure the seamless functioning of the clinic during evening hours.
  • Manage a multi-line phone system, answering calls in a courteous, professional manner.
  • Schedule client appointments and manage clinician calendars efficiently.
  • Prepare, proofread, and format emails, letters, and other documentation with exceptional grammar and quality.
    Maintain physical and digital files, tracking progress on various projects and organizational goals.
Client Experience & Compliance:
  • Provide outstanding, compassionate customer service to clients and referring providers, swiftly resolving any issues that arise.
  • Strictly maintain and ensure the confidentiality of sensitive health information in accordance with federal and state laws.
Financial Administration & Data Entry:
  • Receive, properly document, and process client payments and disbursements.
  • Perform accurate bookkeeping entries (utilizing QuickBooks Online) to support the financial administration of the office.
  • Conduct internet research and manage efficient, error-free data entry across multiple databases and software systems.

Qualifications:
  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree or equivalent administrative work experience. At least 1 year of experience in an administrative, customer-facing role (medical office experience highly preferred).
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with technology, including phone systems, Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel), and general computer hardware. Familiarity with bookkeeping software (QuickBooks Online) is preferred.
  • Skills: Exceptional organizational, multitasking, and time-management abilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong proofreading and grammar.
  • Mindset: A self-starter mentality with independent judgment, high-level confidentiality, and the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently.
  • Bonus: The ability to speak Spanish is a strong plus.

title: Skid-/snowboardlärare & restaurangmedarbetare | Kombitjänst
description:
Nu söker vi nya kollegor till vintersäsongen på en av Sveriges tio största skidorter. Här väntar en spännande och händelserik arbetsplats med skidåkning i toppklass och en idyllisk vintermiljö. Skapa minnen för livet – sök vinterns roligaste jobb i Kungsberget nu!

Dina uppgifter

Som skid-/snowboardlärare hos oss på Kungsberget blir du en del av ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team. Du kommer att arbeta med både barn och vuxna, genom både grupplektioner och privatlektioner. Detta är en utmanande och utvecklande roll som ställer höga krav på din egen åkning och din förmåga att lära ut till andra. Tjänsten kombineras med arbete i våra olika restauranger.

Som restaurangmedarbetare är ditt yttersta mål att se till att vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. Du är vårt ansikte utåt och har arbetsuppgifter så som servering, kassahantering, diskning, dukning, samt andra vanligt förekommande sysslor i en restaurang. Vi ser till att du får rätt upplärning så att du känner dig trygg i alla arbetsuppgifter. Saknar du skidlärarutbildning? Om du är rätt person för oss så hjälper vi dig och betalar delar av utbildningarna.

Urval av arbetsuppgifter:

  • Hålla i skidskolor för både barn och vuxna, i grupp och genom privatlektioner.

  • Arbeta frekvent på fredagar och lördagar.

  • Arbeta intensivt under högtider som jul-, sport- och påsklov.

  • Kvällsarbete förekommer.

Vi erbjuder…

En inspirerande arbetsplats med en härlig sammanhållning där du får chansen att uppleva en vinter som du sent kommer att glömma.

  • Gratis säsongshyra av skidutrustning på nybörjarnivå

  • Rabatt på boende för familj och vänner

  • Förmånliga priser i skiduthyrning, butiker & restauranger.

Vem är du?

Vi ser att du har ett intresse för utförsåkning, tycker om att arbeta med människor och med barn i allmänhet. Du är stresstålig, ställer upp när det behövs och gillar att arbeta över avdelningsgränserna. Att du är glad, positiv och serviceinriktad ser vi som en självklarhet. I Kungsberget tror vi att glada medarbetare leder till glada gäster.

Krav

  • Du kan åka skidor eller snowboard.

  • Du är bekväm med både engelska och svenska språket.

Meriterande

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av att jobba med barn.

  • Restaurangerfarenhet, innefattande kassavana eller hantering av livsmedel.

  • Körkort och tillgång till bil.

Ansök

Detta är en säsongsanställning från december till april och tjänsten går under HRF:s kollektivavtal. Kungsberget samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg för att motverka alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad Proaktiv arbetsplats mot detta.

Sista ansökningsdag är den 1 oktober, men urval sker löpande så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag. Har du frågor? Kontakta avdelningschef Sandra, sandra.rundgren@kungsberget.se.

title: Technology Application Strategy - Java Developer - Assistant Vice President - Citi

Engineer the future of global finance. At Citi, our Tech team doesn't just support finance - we are helping to redefine it. Every day, $5 trillion crosses through our network. We do business in 180+ countries operating at a scale few can match. From deploying advanced AI to helping shape global markets, we build systems that matter. Our mission is to revolutionise the developer experience at Citi, providing innovative tools and platforms that streamline workflows, enhance efficiency, and foster a culture of continuous improvement. title: Staff Backend Engineer (San Francisco)
description:
About the Company

World is a network of real humans, built on privacy-preserving proof-of-human technology, and powered by a globally inclusive financial network that enables the free flow of digital assets for all. It is built to connect, empower, and be owned by everyone.

About the Team

World ID is a digital identity system and proof of humanity for everyone, designed to be a foundational identity protocol for the internet in the era of AGI. It is built to be self-custodial, secure, decentralized and open, setting new standards for privacy and transparency. At the heart of World ID are groundbreaking innovations in hardware and software—spanning distributed systems, cryptography, sensors, biometrics, machine learning and blockchain technology. As part of the team behind World ID, you’ll work on defining and building the decentralized platform that underlies World ID, product experiences and partner integrations. You\'ll help shape the future of technologies needed to realize this ambitious vision.

About the Opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer , you will focus on building core technologies and infrastructure to drive scale, utility and decentralization for World ID protocol and its ecosystem. Your work will span critical technology areas including issuance and registration of credentials, decentralized cloud platform for applications and authenticators lifecycle using MPC systems and blockchain, zero-knowledge proving systems, biometric verification and recovery systems, World network integration platforms and building products using technologies that would delight users.

Responsibilities

  • Architecting and Building: You will take ownership of the design, development, and scaling for mission-critical software, including architecting decentralized, privacy preserving, secure, scalable and reliable backend systems.
  • Technical Leadership: You will provide technical guidance to the engineering team and lead complex, cross-functional projects. Your work will ensure the team delivers elegant and effective solutions for a variety of novel challenges some of which have never been done before.
  • Mentorship and Collaboration: You will mentor junior engineers and work closely with senior leadership, product managers and other XFN stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions that advance the World network.
  • Strategic Impact: You will play a key role in shaping the technical roadmap and strategy for the World ID platform. You are expected to identify the most important tasks and drive them to completion. Your ability to collaborate and stay organized in a fast-paced environment is key.

About you

You have a proven track record of designing and developing exceptional backend systems and solving complex problems, preferably with experience in distributed systems or identity management platforms. You are a fast learner who can quickly master and apply new knowledge and skills. You can communicate clearly and concisely, and your colleagues consistently vouch for your ability to collaborate effectively in ambiguous and changing environments. You are great at building software and are motivated by the challenge of realizing this ambitious vision.

Requirements for this role

  • Experience in senior technical leadership positions.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer till Internationellt produktuppdrag
company: Remote och ev på plats - Stockholm
description:
Vissa människor ser bara en knapp.

Du ser däremot varför någon tvekar innan de klickar. Det är den skillnaden som skiljer en designer från någon som bara ritar gränssnitt.

Vi på Pears tror nämligen att riktigt bra UX börjar långt innan första pixeln hamnar på skärmen.

Den börjar med nyfikenhet, med viljan att förstå människor.Med modet att ifrågasätta lösningar som "alltid har sett ut så".

Om det låter som hur du arbetar finns det ett uppdrag vi tror att du kommer uppskatta.

Senior UX/UI Designer

Designa inte bara appar.

Designa hur människor upplever dem.

Hos Pears söker vi nu en senior UX/UI Designer till ett internationellt produktuppdrag där du får vara med och skapa nästa generations användarupplevelse för Androidbaserade produkter och ett sammanhållet ekosystem av systemapplikationer. Uppdraget omfattar bland annat utveckling av ett modernt designsystem, launcher, systemappar och ett konsekvent visuellt språk för en etablerad mobilplattform.

Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som vill vara med från idé till färdig produkt.

Inte bara leverera design, utan påverka hur den faktiskt byggs. Här får du växa – inte bara leverera

Du blir en del av ett internationellt produktteam där svensk UX/UI-design samverkar med produktledning och Android-utveckling i ett distribuerat leveransupplägg.

Du kommer att arbeta nära utvecklare, produktägare och arkitekter. Inte för att lämna över skisser.

Utan för att tillsammans skapa produkter som människor faktiskt vill använda.

Här finns utrymme att:

  • påverka produktens framtida riktning
  • bygga moderna designsystem
  • utvecklas tillsammans med seniora kollegor
  • omsätta användarbeteenden till verkliga förbättringar
  • bidra till strategiska produktbeslut


Vi söker någon som vill vara med och bygga långsiktigt. Inte bara leverera nästa sprint.

Du kommer hos oss bland annat:

  • Designa moderna användarupplevelser för Android
  • Utveckla ett skalbart Design System
  • Skapa wireframes, användarflöden och interaktiva prototyper
  • Samarbeta tätt med utvecklingsteam kring implementation
  • Säkerställa en konsekvent design genom hela produktfamiljen
  • Bidra till produktstrategi och roadmap
  • Utforska nya idéer och utmana etablerade arbetssätt

Verktyg du sannolikt känner igen. (Du behöver inte kunna allt, men mycket av detta kommer förhoppningsvis kännas bekant):

  • Figma
  • Design Systems
  • Material Design
  • User Research
  • Interaction Design
  • Prototyping
  • Accessibility
  • Agile
  • Jira


Meriterande:

  • Motion Design
  • Android UI
  • Frontendförståelse
  • AI-stöd i designprocessen

Vi tror att du…

…är nyfiken på människor minst lika mycket som på teknik.

...tycker om att förstå varför användare beter sig som de gör.

...vågar ifrågasätta.

...uppskattar utvecklare som utmanar dina idéer.

...tycker att riktigt bra design handlar om att göra komplex teknik enkel.

Inte tvärtom.

Så varför då Pears?

Först och främst tror vi att riktigt bra människor söker mer än nästa uppdrag. De söker människor de kan utvecklas tillsammans med.

På Pears arbetar vi därför nära våra konsulter och tror på små beslutsvägar. Högt förtroende och uppdrag där din kompetens får påverka på riktigt.

Vi rekryterar inte bara konsulter utan bygger team där människor kan utvecklas och skapa verklighet av sina visioner tillsammans.

Ett ord från vår VD Anders Åberg:

"När jag träffar riktigt skickliga designers märker jag snabbt att de sällan pratar om pixlar. De pratar om människor. Om beteenden och om känslor. Någonstans där vet jag redan då att de är precis sådana människor som vi på Pears vill bygga framtidens team tillsammans med."

Anders Åberg

CEO, We are Pears

Arbetsform: Hybrid enligt överenskommelse

Omfattning: Heltid

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

Vi ser att du har ett intresse för utförsåkning och tycker om att arbeta med människor – både vuxna och barn. Detta är en säsongsanställning från november/december till april och tjänsten går under HRF:s kollektivavtal. Kungsberget samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg för att motverka alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad Proaktiv arbetsplats mot detta.

title: Optical Thin Films Research Associate
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Physical Sciences Laboratories (PSL) supports the effective and timely development and operation of national security systems through scientific research and the application of advanced technologies. PSL has more than 150 specialized laboratories used to test, analyze, and troubleshoot virtually every aspect of rocket and satellite system design, development, construction, deployment, and operation. The expertise of the laboratories’ technical staff allows PSL to stay abreast of new technological developments and program support issues associated with rapidly evolving space systems.

The Advanced Materials Processing section of the Materials Processing Department (MPD) within the Space Materials Laboratory (SML) provides expertise and laboratory capabilities in optical materials, thin films, and space environmental effects on materials for advanced space systems. MPD hosts an interdisciplinary team working across materials science, optics, and engineering to design, deposit, and test optical materials for space applications. We are seeking an Optical Thin Films Research Associate – Materials Science Research to support research, technology development, and program activities related to optical coatings, thin films, and optical materials for space applications. The successful candidate will directly support scientists and engineers in development and execution of experiments and in the operation of associated laboratories.

Highlights of our lab's capabilities can be seen here: Virtual Tour

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in El Segundo, CA.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide scientific and laboratory support to programs investigating optical materials and thin films for advanced spacecraft applications in support of National Security Space, NASA, and civil and commercial customers.
  • Operate and utilize materials processing and thin film deposition equipment as well as optical and materials characterization tools and techniques to deposit optical materials and evaluate their behavior.
  • Work closely with technical staff and scientists to develop, design, build, and modify characterization, testing, and analysis methods and tools for optical materials and thin films.
  • Apply standard techniques and procedures to carry out a series of scientific and/or engineering tasks. Resolve experiment, testing, and hardware issues, anomalies, and challenges. Collect, analyze, and present test data.
  • Maintain specialized equipment and capabilities, and ensure proper calibration.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary teams for ongoing research and technical programs. Provide creative solutions to diverse technical problems.
  • Support more than one technical area of the department as needs arise, and support multiple projects concurrently.

What You Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s from an accredited university in materials science, mechanical or aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, physics, optics, or a related science or engineering discipline.
  • Experience or familiarity with thin films, coatings, and optical materials.
  • Prior experience in a laboratory environment and with lab safety protocols.
  • Familiarity with laboratory data collection and data analysis.
  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • Master’s degree from an accredited university in materials science, mechanical or aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, physics, optics, or a related science or engineering discipline.
  • Industry experience in optical coatings and materials, thin film deposition, or optical characterization.
  • Hands-on laboratory experience related to optics, optical materials, or materials processing, including thin film deposition techniques (PVD preferred).
  • Experience with optical modeling of thin films or characterization of optical properties.
  • Experience with one or more of the following: high-vacuum systems and hardware, lasers and optical systems, automation, data acquisition and measurement systems (such as LabVIEW and PLC programming), mechanical design (such as Solidworks) and machining.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance.

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

$84,600.00 - $126,900.00

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

  • Operate Strategically
  • Lead Change

Ways We Reward Our Employees

Ready for a career that matters?

Join City of Moreton Bay, and help shape our city of the future.

title: Talent Administrator
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

ThreatLocker® is a global leader in endpoint protection technologies, providing enterprise-grade cybersecurity solutions that give organizations complete control over their IT environments. The ThreatLocker® platform delivers a full suite of Zero Trust security tools—including Application Allowlisting, Ringfencing™, Storage Control, Elevation Control, Endpoint Network Control, Configuration Management, and Operational Alerts—designed to stop cyberattacks before they happen.

By combining advanced technology with a proactive approach to security, ThreatLocker® empowers businesses, government agencies, and academic institutions to strengthen their defenses, reduce vulnerabilities, and operate with confidence in today’s evolving threat landscape.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Recruitment Administrator is an in-house role that provides vital support to ThreatLocker’s Talent Acquisition team. This position is highly administrative and organizational, with a strong focus on resume review, scheduling, and candidate coordination. You will work closely with the COO, internal recruiters, and cross-departmental teams to ensure recruitment processes run smoothly and candidates experience a professional and welcoming introduction to the company.

This is a professional, front-facing role requiring excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a polished presence. Over time, this role provides a pathway to build sourcing and recruiting skills, with opportunities to expand into broader talent acquisition responsibilities.

JOB SCOPE

The Recruitment Administrator is responsible for, but not limited to:

  • Reviewing resumes and applications to identify candidates who meet role requirements.
  • Conducting research on candidates and talent pools to support recruiters.
  • Managing scheduling: arranging interviews, sending calendar invites, and confirming details with candidates and internal teams.
  • Coordinating and setting up pre-screen calls.
  • Professionally greeting and assisting candidates when they visit the office.
  • Maintaining accurate and organized records within the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse preferred).
  • Preparing candidate summaries and sharing structured feedback with recruiters.
  • Supporting requisition intake meetings with internal teams and the COO.
  • Handling administrative tasks to ensure smooth and efficient recruitment processes.
  • Assisting with outbound sourcing activities and networking for referrals as you grow in the role

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of administrative, recruitment support, or coordination experience.
  • Previous use of an Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse preferred).
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage scheduling and logistics across multiple teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — approachable and engaging.
  • Professional presence, including a neat and professional dress code, when meeting candidates and representing the company.
  • Comfortable with repetitive but critical tasks such as resume review and scheduling.
  • Proactive and eager to grow into broader recruiting responsibilities.
  • Familiarity with hiring best practices and compliance is a plus.

Growth Path

This role is designed as a launch pad into Talent Acquisition. By mastering the administrative, organizational, and candidate-facing aspects of recruiting, you will build the foundation to progress into sourcing, candidate management, and eventually a full-cycle recruiter position.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The duties described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. If necessary, reasonable accommodation may be requested and will be evaluated for its relationship to the essential functions that must be performed.

  • Job will generally be performed in an office environment but may require travel to visit company offices and/or property locations.
  • While performing duties of this job, would occasionally require to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects and tools.
  • Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perceptions, and the ability to adjust focus.

Our agents execute real workflows: they call tools, integrate with third‑party systems, and operate over complex, evolving data. This role owns the backend systems that make agents dependable in production—agent runtime services, integrations, data modeling, observability, and platform reliability. You will work in a high‑velocity environment with real ownership: you’ll design systems, ship quickly, measure outcomes, and harden the platform as it scales.

What you’ll do

  • Own core backend services powering agents : build and operate the agent runtime services (tool execution, state management, orchestration, retries, idempotency, rate limiting).
  • Design robust APIs and contracts : develop stable, well‑versioned APIs (internal + external), including webhook/event interfaces and integration adapters.
  • Model complex domain data : design schemas and data access patterns that support agent memory/state, workflow history, audit trails, permissions, and multi‑tenant isolation.
  • Integrations at scale : implement and maintain high‑quality integrations (OAuth, webhooks, sync engines, connectors) with strong observability and failure handling.
  • Reliability engineering : define and improve SLIs/SLOs, implement end‑to‑end tracing, build safety rails (timeouts, circuit breakers, budgets), and run incident response.
  • Platform performance and cost control : optimize throughput/latency, queue backlogs, caching, storage, and inference/tool‑call costs; build guardrails for runaway tasks.
  • Raise engineering standards : drive code quality, testing strategy, on‑call hygiene, runbooks, postmortems, and mentoring.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience : 6+ years building backend systems for production SaaS, platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Backend depth : strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, queues/workers, caching, and production operations.
  • Data modeling strength : excellent relational modeling (Postgres/MySQL), migrations, indexing, query optimization, and data correctness.
  • API design excellence : proven ability to design clear, evolvable APIs and contracts across services and external partners.
  • High pace + high quality : you thrive in fast‑moving environments without sacrificing reliability or security.
  • Curiosity and ownership : you enjoy ambiguous problems, learn quickly, and take systems end‑to‑end (build → ship → operate).

Nice to have

  • LLM experience : building product with LLMs (prompting, tool calling, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs).
  • Agent architecture familiarity : orchestration patterns, planning/execution loops, memory/state, sandboxed tool execution, human‑in‑the‑loop, safety constraints.

The HOAi Way

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Backend-Leaning) (San Francisco)
description:
About Collate

Collate is an AI document generation platform for life sciences. We automate paperwork with AI, helping our customers get life-saving innovations to patients years faster. Collate is an end-to-end solution, powering every step of drug, diagnostic, and medical device development—from concept to market.

Our Leadership

Our CEO Surbhi Sarna is a former General Partner at Y Combinator. Surbhi founded nVision Medical, which developed a new method to detect ovarian cancer and was acquired by Boston Scientific. Our CTO Nate Smith is a former Visiting Partner at Y Combinator and founder of Lever. Our AI researchers, engineers, and designers have worked at Google, Nvidia, Meta, Netflix, Amazon, AirBnB, Hippocratic AI, and Grail, and 40% of our team are former founders.

We’re a small, elite team, with over $30M in seed funding from top investors (Redpoint, First Round Capital, Conviction, and Y Combinator) and leaders in healthcare and AI. This is a rare chance to join at the ground floor of a company with world-changing potential, experienced founders, and resources to execute at scale.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Full‑Stack Engineer (Backend‑leaning) to design and build the systems and user‑facing features that power Collate. You’ll spend most of your time on backend challenges—APIs, services, and infrastructure—but you’ll also ship end‑to‑end features.

This is an opportunity to help define our technical foundation, collaborate directly with design and product, and shape how our users experience Collate from day one.

Modern Tech Stack

Collate uses a modern tech stack, targeting a highly reliable and available platform. We use Go for scalable backend services, TypeScript & React for frontend development, and Python for AI & ML services. Our infrastructure is hosted on AWS with Kubernetes for orchestration and Terraform + Argo CD for configuration management. Key systems include S3, PostgreSQL, Kafka, OpenSearch, LLMs, and other AI models.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and scale backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that power Collate’s products.
  • Deliver end‑to‑end, production‑ready features in partnership with product, design, and AI engineering.
  • Balance iteration speed with technical rigor to ensure systems scale reliably.
  • Create internal tools and workflows that accelerate engineering productivity.
  • Share responsibility for production systems, including participating in on‑call rotation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Have experience building across the stack, with deeper strength in backend systems.
  • Enjoy taking features from idea → backend architecture → polished UI.
  • Care deeply about both technical robustness and the end user experience.
  • Are motivated by ambiguity, eager to pick up missing knowledge, and excited to solve novel problems.
  • Value speed, pragmatism, and scrappiness but know when to design for robustness.
  • Have been an early‑stage engineer or startup founder—or aspire to work at that level of ownership.

Why Join Collate?

Impact: Build systems and experiences that touch real patients and providers, improving healthcare outcomes.

Ownership: Shape both our product experience and our engineering culture from the start.

Learning: Collaborate with a uniquely interdisciplinary team—AI researchers, healthcare leaders, and experienced startup builders.

Upside: Join a company early enough to have meaningful equity and career‑defining impact.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$350,000 USD annually, depending on experience and level (Tier 1, San Francisco).

As a Systems Engineering - Logistics Analyst, you’ll be an integral part of the Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) team interfacing directly with team members and stakeholders, including customers and program leaders.

In this role, you’re responsible for the development and maintenance of detailed Logistics Supportability Analysis, Provisioning data for parts, Spares Analysis and Spares Availability for hardware within a specific product line. You will work with limited supervision, applying advanced logistics principles and engineering judgment to independently develop, refine, and improve supportability and sustainment products.

Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) is responsible for ensuring our products are safe, reliable, maintainable, and delivered on time. The organization is comprised of multiple disciplines that support engineering teams, program offices, and our customers. LCE disciplines are engaged throughout the entire product life cycle—from initial concept and design through deployment, sustainment, and eventual deactivation.

What You Will Do

  • ​Independently develop and maintain supportability analyses and provisioning data, ensuring accuracy and alignment with engineering and program requirements.

  • Apply advanced logistics principles and analytical judgment to develop and enhance complex program-level concepts and plans with limited supervision.

  • Collaborate with cross‑product teams, including Chief Engineers, Program Directors, Program Managers, and customers, influencing decisions using data-driven supportability insights.

  • Lead or support spares analysis and spares availability modeling, identifying improvements to methods and data quality.

  • Work autonomously within your work area, contributing to moderately complex projects, and setting objectives for your own tasks that support broader program goals.

  • 10% or less Domestic and/or International Travel May Be Required.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field.

  • Experience with one or more of the following: data analysis, data collection, logistics, Engineering Documentation, Configuration Management (CM), or Product Data Management (PDM).

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with various areas of the Technical Data Package (drawings, parts lists, and electrical schematics) and experience generating/interpreting Parts List, system drawings and/or logistics plans.

  • Spares Analysis and Spares List Development (Poisson Based Statistical Analysis, OPUS Suite, or similar analysis software experience)

  • Experience in performing Level of Repairability Analysis (LORA) using COMPASS and/or OPUS.

  • Experience in the development and maintenance of Logistics Management Information (LMI) in accordance with MIL-STD-1388-2B, GEIA-STD-0007, or MIL-PRF-49506

  • Experience utilizing EAGLE, POWERLOG or SLICWave tools

title: Backend Engineer (Washington)
description:
We are sourcing on behalf of HIFI, which is a financial infrastructure platform for the modern internet. Businesses around the world—from fast-growing fintech startups to global financial institutions—use HIFI to move money across stablecoins, fiat rails, and onchain systems through a single programmable interface.

Customers use HIFI to automate payments, orchestrate treasury, power embedded finance products, and launch new global money workflows without needing to build or manage complex banking, blockchain, or compliance infrastructure themselves.

Their mission is to make money programmable by default, and to give developers and businesses the tools to move value instantly, globally, and with software-level control.

About the Team

The HIFI platform team builds the infrastructure, developer experiences, and financial workflows that power stablecoin-native finance at scale. The team designs and maintains the APIs, user-facing tools, and partner integrations that allow customers to create accounts, move money across bank and blockchain rails, and operate compliant global payment systems.

We work across the full lifecycle of modern money movement—from account creation and ledgering, to fiat and stablecoin settlement, to global payouts and onchain connectivity. Our customers span fintech platforms, marketplaces, exchanges, neobanks, payroll providers, and tokenized asset platforms operating across the U.S., Europe, Africa, LatAm, and MENA.

This is an opportunity to help build one of the fastest-growing segments of financial infrastructure and define how money moves on the internet over the next decade.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to help build the critical systems that power HIFI’s global stablecoin payment infrastructure. You’ll work on our APIs, ledgering and settlement services, developer tooling, and the core transaction logic that moves money instantly and securely across bank networks and blockchains.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, compliance, and frontend teams to enable seamless experiences for enterprise developers. This is an opportunity to shape foundational services that support billions in global transaction volume.

This role is based in-person in New York, working closely with our small and fast-moving engineering team.

We value people who:

  • Find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering and defining problems as much as solving them
  • Deliver — you may enjoy thoughtful conversations and perfecting designs, but in the end, you care about building reliable solutions that ship
  • Communicate clearly and comfortably across teams, asking questions, sharing ideas, and speaking up
  • Learn quickly, stay curious, and adapt to new challenges with a growth mindset
  • Move fast and stay effective in ambiguous, evolving environments, with a strong sense of urgency to get things done
  • Give and receive feedback openly, and collaborate across functions
  • Bring passion and experience — for Web3, modern payment solutions, or anything else — and channel it into their work

Responsibilities

Core Infrastructure Engineering

  • Architect, implement, and evolve backend services that power real-time bank-to-stablecoin settlement and ledger operations
  • Build scalable, resilient microservices and APIs handling high-volume financial transactions
  • Develop robust data models, transaction orchestration logic, and state-management systems
  • Own services end-to-end: deployment pipelines, observability, and operational excellence

Performance, Reliability & Security

  • Design for high-throughput, low-latency execution across distributed environments
  • Implement advanced monitoring, automated rollback strategies, and fault-tolerant failover
  • Apply best practices in secure system design, encryption, and identity-aware workflows
  • Continuously tune compute, storage, and networking to maintain strict SLAs
  • Work closely with product, compliance, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver enterprise-grade capabilities
  • Translate financial, regulatory, and settlement requirements into scalable backend logic
  • Participate in architectural reviews and shape standards for backend systems

Infrastructure for Global Scale

  • Contribute to infrastructure capable of supporting billions in global transaction volume
  • Extend corridor capabilities across new chains, bank partners, and payment networks
  • Ensure systems adapt seamlessly to increased demand and evolving regulatory environments

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years building and maintaining production backend systems
  • Strong proficiency in modern backend languages (e.g., Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, or Java)
  • Experience with RESTful services, APIs, distributed systems, and relational databases (Postgres/MySQL)
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, queues/streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS, etc.)
  • Understanding of how backend systems interface with security, identity, and risk controls
  • Good product instincts. You think about user outcomes, not just implementation details
  • Experience delivering production features in fast-paced, high-ownership environments

Preferred Skills & Experience

Interested candidates who meet the basic qualifications should consider applying. The following preferred skills and experience are helpful for this role, but candidates with only some of them are able to be successful on our team. Learning on the job is critical success and part of the excitement of working at HIFI.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, liquidity or settlement systems
  • Exposure to AML/KYC compliance workflows, identity services, or financial transaction monitoring
  • Familiarity with security fundamentals for financial systems, such as encryption, key management, tokenization, and fintech application security best practices
  • Prior startup experience or comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth conditions

The AI Strategy & Adoption Lead will play a critical role in ensuring Gallagher maximises the value of its investment in Artificial Intelligence (AI) by driving adoption, engagement, and measurable outcomes across our UK Trading Divisions and Enterprise Solutions.

This is a business-facing role that requires a strategic mindset and the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite executives. While not a purely technical position, we require a solid understanding of AI technologies and their potential applications within a business context.

This role will be responsible for identifying opportunities to leverage AI to enhance operations, improve decision-making, and deliver value across Gallagher UK. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills are essential, as this role will involve collaborating with diverse teams to champion AI adoption and ensure alignment with organisational goals.

If you are passionate about the transformative potential of AI and have the expertise to bridge the gap between technology and business strategy, we would love to hear from you.

We offer hybrid working and this will be a mix of office based and home working. This role will require travel across our 60+ offices up and down the UK & Ireland.


How you'll make an impact

  • Act as the primary AI advocate and point of contact for our UK Trading Divisions, ensuring alignment with Gallagher’s overall AI strategy.
  • Build fantastic relationships with key stakeholders, including business executives, IT teams, and operational leaders, to identify opportunities for AI to address business challenges.
  • Increase the use and value of Gallagher’s AI investments by identifying, prioritising, and sponsoring impactful use cases within the business division.
  • Collaborate with the IT AI working group, the global AI committee, and the Gallagher Global Broking global AI lead to ensure local and global AI initiatives are effectively implemented and deliver measurable benefits.
  • Promote AI literacy within the business division, ensuring employees understand the potential and limitations of AI technologies.
  • Ensure appropriate training is delivered to upskill teams and enable them to effectively leverage AI tools and solutions.
  • Develop and deliver clear, consistent, and engaging communications around AI initiatives, successes, and opportunities.
  • Actively participate in and contribute to the AI champions network, serving as a visible and vocal advocate for AI.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement by championing AI initiatives.

About You

  • A proven background and understanding of AI technologies, their applications, and their potential impact on business processes.
  • Knowledge and experience of the general and Lloyds/London Insurance Market.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior executives.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience in organising and facilitating workshops, focus groups, and training sessions.
  • Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and ethical considerations related to AI.
  • Extensive experience in business leadership, IT, or digital transformation roles, with a focus on AI or data analytics.
  • Demonstrated success in implementing AI initiatives and delivering measurable business value.
  • Familiarity with the insurance industry and its unique challenges is highly desirable.

Compensation and benefits

We are seeking an experienced Privileged Access Management (PAM) Architect/Lead to design, implement, and manage enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management solutions that strengthen security, governance, and compliance across critical IT environments. This role is ideal for professionals with deep expertise in PAM technologies, identity security, and access governance who are passionate about protecting enterprise infrastructure from privileged access risks.

As a PAM specialist, you will work closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and compliance teams to develop secure privileged access strategies, implement best practices, and ensure robust identity protection across on-premises and cloud environments. You will play a key role in driving PAM transformation initiatives, improving security posture, and ensuring regulatory compliance while mentoring technical teams and supporting enterprise security architecture.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage enterprise-wide Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions for critical systems and infrastructure.
  • Define and implement privileged access governance, credential management, password vaulting, session monitoring, and privileged account lifecycle management.
  • Integrate PAM platforms with Active Directory, cloud identity providers, enterprise applications, servers, databases, and network devices.
  • Develop privileged access policies, security standards, and operational procedures aligned with cybersecurity best practices.
  • Lead PAM deployment, upgrades, migrations, and platform optimization initiatives across enterprise environments.
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and application teams to secure privileged identities and administrative access.
  • Monitor privileged access activities, investigate security incidents, and recommend remediation measures to reduce operational risk.
  • Support regulatory compliance initiatives by implementing audit controls, reporting mechanisms, and privileged access reviews.
  • Automate privileged access workflows using scripting, APIs, and infrastructure automation tools where applicable.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineering teams, and contribute to continuous improvements in identity and access security.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 12+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Identity & Access Management, or Enterprise Security, with strong expertise in Privileged Access Management (PAM).
  • Proven experience implementing and administering enterprise PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea (Thycotic), One Identity, or similar solutions.
  • Strong understanding of privileged identity governance, credential vaulting, session management, least privilege, and zero trust security principles.
  • Experience securing hybrid cloud, on-premises, and multi-cloud environments across Windows, Linux, databases, and network infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), LDAP, SSO, MFA, RBAC, and identity federation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, security auditing, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities with experience handling complex enterprise security environments.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for enhancing enterprise security, reducing privileged access risks, and driving continuous improvement in identity security practices.

Vi söker nu nya stjärnor till vårt team i Kristianstad.

Som B2B-säljare och företagsrådgivare hjälper du företag att hitta smarta lösningar inom telefoni, bredband och kommunikation genom Telia Företag.

Vi vet att många söker mer än bara ett jobb. Därför erbjuder vi en arbetsplats där du kan växa, utvecklas och skapa framtida karriärmöjligheter.

Du behöver inte vara expert på försäljning för att lyckas hos oss.

  • Har höga ambitioner och vill utvecklas
  • Trivs med att arbeta mot mål
  • Är positiv, driven och lösningsorienterad
  • Vill skapa resultat och samtidigt ha roligt på jobbet

Många av våra mest framgångsrika medarbetare började utan tidigare erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning.

Krav för tjänsten

  • Fullständig gymnasieutbildning
  • God datorvana
  • Flytande svenska i tal och skrift

Om Telisol

Telisol grundades 2005 och är idag en av Telias närmaste partners inom företagsförsäljning. Vi hjälper företag över hela Sverige med telefoni-, bredbands- och kommunikationslösningar.

Vår framgång bygger på tre värderingar:

Passion – Vi brinner för det vi gör.

Handlingskraft – Vi tar initiativ och skapar resultat.

Ansvar – Vi tar ansvar att det blir gjort.

title: Pædagog, gerne nyuddannet
description:
Vi tilbyder introduktionsforløb og du får tildelt en erfaren mentor

Pædagog, gerne nyuddannet søges til Børnehuset Klatretræet i naturskønne omgivelser i Hornbæk.

I Børnehuset Klatretræet søger vi en ny kollegaer/pædagog til vores børnehavebørn pr. 1/9 2026. Vi er en gruppe glade pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere som søger en ny kollega – fuldtid eller deltid det er op til dig.

Klatretræet er et fantastisk dagtilbud, der danner rammen for 135 skønne børns hverdag. Børnehus er fordelt på to matrikler, som er beliggende tæt på skov og strand, og i gåafstand til S. stationen.

Vi bruger generelt vores lokale område rigtig meget, og deltager aktivt i Hornbæks lokal miljø hele året. Det kan være Hornbækhavn, den nærliggende hal, Hornbækkirke, bryghuset i skoven, men vi kan også finde på at tage ud af børnehuset og tager til Louisiana og ser på kunst og aktiviteter.

Vi er et børnehus, hvor man gerne må grine højt, tænke nyt, få mudder på bukserne og udfordre “plejer”, når det giver mening. Vi er et dagtilbud af høj pædagogisk kvalitet, hvilket også kan ses i vores tilsyn, og vi er meget glade for det arbejde vi udføre hverdag.

Vi arbejder med en organisering hvor vi hjælper hinanden i hverdagens mange pædagogiske arbejdsopgaver. Vi er bl.a. ved at organisere tid til forberedelse for pædagogerne og pædagogmøder, hvor vi mødes på tværs af de to matrikler og sammen reflektere og drøfter vores pædagogiske arbejde i forhold til børnene og børnefællesskabet.

Vi arbejder målrettet med:
  • Rutiner
  • Små børnegrupper
  • Tydelige legemiljøer – inde og ud

Som arbejdsplads tilbyder vi.
  • En stor natur legeplads, som giver mulighed for alt slags udeliv. De 4 børnehavestuer har alle egen udgang til legepladsen.
  • Vi arbejder med en faglig didaktisk ramme, og du skal have lyst til at arbejde og lege med læringsmiljøer ude/inde, trives med refleksion og deltage aktivt på pædagogfaglige møder.
  • Sideoplæring på opgaver som du endnu ikke er helt rustet til at udføre.
  • Et stort hus med gode kollegaer som har lyst til at lykkes sammen, så alle børn i børnehuset Klatretræet oplever sig som en del af børnefællesskabet.
  • Vi er ved at organisere, så pædagogerne kan få fast forberedelsestid i hverdagen.

Hvis du kan sige ja til 2 ud af 5 punkter, bliver vi glade 😊
  • Kan fastholde aftaler og omsætte mål til praksis. Dvs. planlægge og udføre pædagogiske forløb i forhold til den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan samt dokumentere og evaluere dit arbejde med børnene.
  • Har erfaring med, eller mod på at arbejde med forældresamarbejde på stuen samt på tværs af organisationen.
  • Elsker at lege og blev uddannet, fordi du har ambitioner på børns vegne
  • Har en god portion humor hvor vi hver især rumme hinandens forskelligheder.
  • Er glad for at være ude i naturen i al slags vejr, fordi påklædningen ikke er en hindring men udelive er sjovt og naturen sætter en fantastisk rammen for børnenes fantasi.
Er du interesseret i at komme forbi og besøg os er du velkommen, ellers høre vi gerne fra dig hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingsopslaget. Du vil få en ledelse der lytter – og kolleger, der både griner, sparrer og deler hverdagens små guldøjeblikke. Ring til leder Susanne Gottschalck på tlf: 2531 1336 eller souschef Ida Rostgaard på tlf: 4928 1145.

Ansøgningsfrist og samtale
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og forbeholder os retten til at lukke annoncen, hvis det rette kandidat findes inden ansøgningsfristen d. 22/8- 2026 kl. 12.00. Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst.
Der vil blive hentet børneattest og straffeattest i henhold til gældende regler

I Helsingør Kommune vægter vi, at medarbejdere og ledere udvikler deres faglighed. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe sammenhæng mellem den ambitiøse udvikling af hele organisationen Helsingør Kommune og videreuddannelse af både medarbejdere og ledere – fagligt og personligt.

9 ud af 10 indbyggere bor mindre end 2 km fra vandet. Her mødes Hamlet og Kronborg med verdenskendt arkitektur og en hyggelig middelalderby på ét og samme sted. Tjek #OplevHelsingor og se selv.

title: Staff iOS Engineer (San Francisco)
description:
Company

Credit Genie is a mobile‑first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash and build credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long‑term financial stability.

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder, Credit Genie is backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as PayPal, Square, and Cash App. We are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting‑edge technology and customer‑centric solutions.

Overview

We are looking for a Staff iOS Engineer to help architect our Mobile Apps for the next 2‑3 years of growth. The ideal candidate should have experience leading the design and development of mobile apps with high quality, stability, and low latency.

Are you passionate about building high‑quality iOS apps and excited by the challenge of re‑architecting a product from the ground up? As a Staff iOS Engineer, you’ll lead key components of our mobile app as we expand into brand new product areas. You’ll collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams to ensure our mobile app scales and evolves to meet the needs of millions of users.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers to architect new products and define a compelling UX that functions well within an iOS mobile app.
  • Provide iOS mobile app expertise, helping improve the team’s development practices, design patterns, deployment processes, and customer experience.
  • Work with stakeholders from product, marketing, etc. on initiatives aligning with our KPIs and business priorities.
  • Write code for app design, features, components, and integrations in a clean, readable, and reusable fashion.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in standard engineering practices such as code reviews, standups, planning meetings, and product/technology demos.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential to enhance the Credit Genie product suite and maintain our competitive edge.
  • Mentor and develop other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional mobile development.
  • Proficient in Swift.
  • Deep understanding of mobile app UX best practices.
  • Experience leading large-scale projects and partnering directly with product, marketing, and engineering teams in a highly iterative environment.
  • Ability to propose, refine, code, and update UX/product solutions to ensure they meet customer needs.
  • Proficiency in taking design mocks (including Figma files) and coding them in‑app using Swift.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working on personal finance management (PFM) products.
  • Understanding of UX design concepts (e.g. density, diversity) and the languages, systems, principles, and processes used in design creation.
  • Comfort using design prototyping tools (e.g. Figma, InVision, Origami, or Sketch).
  • Ability to maintain a style guide, UI kit, and brand.
  • Familiarity with consumer credit risk and the customer life cycle.

Benefits And Perks

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness. We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.

Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

  • 100% company‑paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment.
  • Monthly fitness reimbursement up to $100 or a full membership to LifeTime Fitness.
  • 401(k) with a 2.5% match and immediate vesting.
  • Meal program for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
  • Life and accidental insurance.
  • Flexible PTO.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case‑by‑case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job‑related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.

Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.
