title: Communication Disorders Full-time Professional CFS (tenure) track (2 Positions)
description:
​Job Title:

Department of Communication Disorders Faculty (Full-Time, Professional Teaching) - 2 Positions

Posting End Date: October 1, 2026

*NOTE: Last day to apply is Wednesday, September 30, 2026 @ 11:59 p.m. (MST)

Position Start Date: July 1, 2027

Required Degree:

Master's or Doctorate in Speech-Language Pathology

The required degree must be completed by the start date.

Experience:

  • Earned Master's or doctorate degree in Speech-Language Pathology from an accredited university.

  • Teaching experience including ability to develop curriculum, prepare teaching materials, and instruct students in small group or large classroom settings.

  • Ability to initiate and manage student learning experiences in areas related to the field of communication disorders.

  • Current Certificate of Clinical Competence from the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA).

  • Clinical experience, preferably in range of settings and service delivery areas.

Duties/Expectations:

  • Provide high-quality classroom instruction to undergraduate and graduate students in the field of communication sciences and disorders.

  • Under the direction of the department chair complete one or more of the following assignments:

  • Create, manage and supervise student experiential learning opportunities

  • Assist in providing clinical education opportunities for undergraduate students

  • Facilitate interprofessional education opportunities for undergraduate students (e.g., nursing, BYU child laboratory, medical school)

  • Supervise the Communication Disorders Peer Mentor program

  • Manage community outreach and educational programs that enhance undergraduate and graduate student learning

  • Assist in the preparation of documentation for program reviews and national accreditation efforts

Position Summary:

The McKay School of Education at Brigham Young University invites applications for a Continuing Faculty Status track (tenure track equivalent) professional teaching position in the Department of Communication Disorders. Starting rank and salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

This faculty position will focus on providing high-quality instruction to undergraduate and graduate students in the field of communication sciences and disorders, teaching a range of courses that support the academic clinical preparation of future speech-language pathologists or audiologists, while promoting the mission and aims of a BYU education. A portion of this position will also involve student mentoring, clinical service, and administration as directed by the department chair.

Documents Required at the Time of Application: Please attach your updated curriculum vitae, cover letter and Mission Alignment Statement to the faculty application.

Note: Failure to attach the required documents may result in your application not being considered.

This position requires the successful candidate to relocate and/or reside in Utah for the duration of their employment.

MISSION ALIGNMENT STATEMENT INSTRUCTIONS

If you are a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints:

BYU is committed to hiring faculty members who enthusiastically embrace and energetically advance its unique mission. To this end, please include a one-page mission alignment statement as part of your application that addresses how you might, as a BYU faculty member: (1) live a life of loyalty to Jesus Christ and His restored Church and align yourself with doctrine and teachings declared by living prophets, seers, and revelators; (2) demonstrate intentionality in building faith in Jesus Christ and testimony of His restored gospel among students and others in the BYU community; and (3) teach your subject matter with the Spirit of God and strive to keep it “bathed in the light and color of the restored gospel” (Spencer W. Kimball).

If you are not a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints:

Applicants who are not members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints include a one-page mission alignment statement that describes understanding of and commitment to the Mission of Brigham Young University and the AIMS of a BYU Education.

EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS

All new employees who are members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints will be required to hold and be worthy to hold a current temple recommend.

All faculty are required to abide by the university’s Honor Code and Dress & Grooming Standards. Preference is given to qualified candidates who are members in good standing of the affiliated church, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Successful candidates are expected to support and contribute to the academic and religious missions of the university within the context of the principles and doctrine of the affiliated church.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Brigham Young University is an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

title: Technical Product Lead, PipeDiver
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

The Role

As the Technical Product Lead, you'll play a critical role within Xylem's Operational Readiness Team. You'll be responsible for developing the documentation, training, processes, and technical standards that enable successful delivery of our products around the world.

Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Learning & Development, Asset Management, Project Delivery, and Business Development teams, you'll ensure our products are supported by world-class operational practices while helping shape future product improvements.

You'll serve as the technical authority for the PipeDiver® product line, supporting both field operations and product development by translating technical knowledge into practical, scalable solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and continuously improve operational processes for the PipeDiver® product line and supporting equipment.
  • Develop technical documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), assembly instructions, testing procedures, maintenance manuals, and repair documentation.
  • Design, develop, and deliver technical training programs in classroom, shop, field, and online environments.
  • Build internal training capability by developing in-house trainers and expanding online learning programs.
  • Manage the maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, and readiness of operational equipment.
  • Support high-profile, technically complex, or non-standard field projects by providing technical guidance and training.
  • Evaluate the technical feasibility of projects and provide recommendations during proposal development.
  • Monitor operational issues and identify opportunities for process improvements or product enhancements.
  • Collaborate with Product Engineering and Product Management to successfully transition new products and product upgrades into field operations.
  • Review technical marketing materials to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Champion quality, safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the product lifecycle.

What You'll Bring:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical project delivery or field operations role, including technical planning and delivery.
  • 4-year degree in a technical field or expository writing (preferred)
  • Demonstrated expertise supporting complex technical products in an operational environment.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, work instructions, and Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to mentor, coach, and develop technical staff.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify process gaps and implement practical solutions.
  • Ability to balance standardization with flexibility while maintaining safety and quality.

Work Environment:

This position is primarily office and warehouse based, with occasional travel to support field projects and training initiatives.

The successful candidate must be able to:

  • Lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Climb ladders.
  • Work in confined spaces when required.
  • Travel up to 25% of the time.

title: Software Engineer Manager, Kubernetes Networking (Sunnyvale)
description:
Software Engineer Manager, Kubernetes Networking

corporate_fare Google place Sunnyvale, CA, USA

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience with networking.
  • 3 years of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems.
  • 2 years of experience in a people management role managing direct reports.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 5 years of experience managing large-scale Kubernetes or Docker environments.
  • Experience with eBPF, in-kernel networking, data plane and control plane elements.

About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Google Distributed Cloud is a portfolio of fully managed hardware and software solutions which extends Google Cloud’s infrastructure and services to the edge and into your data centers. In this role, you will be responsible for building networking solutions and networking abstractions for these environments and drive solutions integration and validation efforts collaborating with Partners and Customers. Additionally, you will be focusing on building kubevirt networking solution, bootstrapping networking for new GDC platforms, enhancing our feature‑reach portfolio of security and services built on top of GDC Network Gateway, consolidating Dataplane‑v2 support among all GDC environments where Kubernetes runs.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop an engineering team by shaping career growth, managing sprint velocity, and allocating resources to balance immediate customer commitments with long‑term architectural health.
  • Direct the roadmap, strategy, and execution for Google Distributed Cloud (GDC)-hosted networking virtualization solutions, collaborating with platform, GDC, Anthos networking teams, and adjacent stakeholders.
  • Guide the design and development of network connectivity solutions involving both data plane and control plane elements for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments.
  • Direct the design and delivery of network virtualization solutions tailored for container and virtual machine (VM) workloads operating on Kubernetes platforms.
  • Advocate operational excellence by assisting external GDC customers and resolving issues within production clusters.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207,000 – $301,000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits.

title: Staff Backend Engineer (Palo Alto)
description:
Overview

Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation. Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution. Engineers automate our development processes and observability to ensure systems are healthy and maintainable. We are seeking engineers who want to have outsized impact in a company of our size (~350 employees, half in engineering).

Responsibilities

  • Work with a team of engineers to design and build new features or enhancements to existing features. This work will add capabilities to backend systems and services, with automated instrumentation and monitoring to require minimal operational maintenance.
  • Help improve the maintainability and stability of the codebase by fixing issues and adding necessary enhancements to existing backend systems.
  • Ensure mission-critical backend systems and services operate smoothly in production by triaging and resolving operational issues as part of a team of on-call engineers.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improving the reliability and scalability of our systems.
  • Participate in recruiting activities such as interviewing and attending career fairs.
  • Provide mentorship to other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in developing backend components, services or APIs in Java or a similar language.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of distributed systems and functional programming paradigms.
  • Knowledge of SQL and experience working with online data stores (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server).
  • Passion for agile, test-driven development, continuous integration and automated testing; interest in platforms and backend systems with measurable business impact; ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Nice-to-have: experience with Spark pipelines; knowledge of an ORM (e.g., Hibernate); exposure to a dependency injection framework (e.g., Guice, Spring, Pico, Dagger).
  • Educational requirement: BS or MS in computer science or related field.

What Wealthfront Will Offer

  • Mentorship through a structured onboarding program.
  • Opportunities to work on projects aligned with your professional goals.
  • Professional development support with feedback during weekly 1:1s and semi-annual reviews.
  • Autonomy to help you be a happy and successful member of our team.

Estimated annual salary range: $208,000 - $228,000 USD plus equity and a discretionary bonus.

Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more.

title: Sustainability Data & Energy Analyst
description:
The Sustainability Data & Energy Analyst plays a critical role in analyzing, forecasting, and optimizing the company’s energy usage, utility spend, and sustainability performance. This position leads complex data modeling, energy performance analysis, and reporting initiatives that support cost reduction, operational efficiency, carbon reduction strategies, and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate combines strong technical analytics skills with deep knowledge of energy systems, utility data, emissions accounting and ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of colleagues, from facilities technicians to senior leaders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Energy & Utility Data Analytics

  • Collect, clean, and analyze utility and resource consumption data across facilities, assets, and operations. Resources to include, at a minimum, fuels, gases, chemicals, water, waste and energy.
  • Develop dashboards, performance indicators, and analytics tools to monitor energy and resource consumption, trends, anomalies, and savings opportunities.
  • Conduct variance analysis, cost modeling, and root‑cause investigations of energy performance deviations.
  • Identify and quantify energy efficiency opportunities, load optimization strategies, and cost‑saving programs.
  • Develop and deliver effective data-related trainings to ensure high fidelity incoming data. Conduct spot checks and check-ins with employees across global sites to confirm uptake and understanding.

2. Forecasting & Modeling

  • Build and support modelling for Scopes 1, 2, 3, water and waste goals, configure models to ensure dynamic conditions are incorporated, assumptions documented, and risks to performance are evident and monitored.
  • Build and maintain forecasting models for Scopes 1, 2, 3 and water, and waste.
  • Build and maintain energy forecasting models for electricity, fuel, thermal energy, and peak demand, incorporating traditional and clean energy sources.
  • Support financial planning with energy budget models, scenario analysis, and rate/tariff evaluations.
  • Evaluate the financial and operational impacts of energy price fluctuations, weather patterns, utility programs, and operational changes.

3. Sustainability & Emissions Accounting

  • Manage greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions data collection, accounting, accuracy, and completeness across Scopes 1, 2, and 3.
  • Prepare energy, emissions, and resource consumption data for corporate sustainability reporting (e.g., CDP, GRI, TCFD, ISSB, CSRD).
  • Analyze the energy and emissions impacts of operational initiatives, equipment upgrades, and renewable energy projects.
  • Develop standardized tools to direct site-level environmental accounting and reporting; whether SaaS, homegrown, or hybrid tools

4. Third-party Assurance and Audit Support

  • Prepare audit‑ready datasets, documentation, evidence, and data dictionaries for energy and GHG emissions assurance reviews.
  • Serve as a key liaison between external auditors/assurance providers and internal teams.
  • Support walkthroughs, sampling, and testing procedures by providing source data, calculations, and methodological explanations.
  • Maintain traceable audit trails, version control, and documentation to meet assurance requirements (limited or reasonable assurance).
  • Implement auditor feedback to strengthen internal controls and improve future assurance readiness.
  • Assist in annual internal reviews of data processes, methodologies, and system controls to reduce audit findings and risks.

5. Energy Systems & Operations Support

  • Support the assessment and validation of energy conservation measures and capital projects.
  • Evaluate clean energy and on-site generation opportunities (solar, storage, microgrids, fuel switching, etc.). Partner with site facility teams to explore and evaluate opportunities in priority countries/regions, including but not limited to India and Israel.
  • Conduct research, develop proposals with supporting evidence re: clean energy and energy efficiency opportunities - work with Facilities, Finance and Sustainability teams to develop energy strategy to support Sandisk's 100% clean energy by 2035 and Net Zero Scope 1 & 2 by 2040 targets.

6. Data Engineering & Digital Tools

  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, automation scripts, and analytics models using SQL, Python, BI tools.
  • Manage sustainability data systems, and visualization (e.g., Power BI/Tableau).
  • Understand, support, and implement data governance improvements, quality control processes, and documentation standards. Support Sustainability Data Governance Lead with periodic reviews of governance model effectiveness and efficiency and driving continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with the Data Automation Team to design and deploy digital tools that streamline operational reporting, automate manual data collection, and improve real-time visibility of manufacturing performance.
  • Support automation pathways for renewable energy and Carbon-Free Energy (CFE) allocation based on customer demand, enabling efficient energy utilization through digital systems and process automation.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Science, Environmental Science, Energy Management, Economics, or related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in energy analytics, sustainability data management, utility data analysis, or related technical field.
  • Strong proficiency in data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Excel, PowerBI/Tableau).
  • Knowledge of energy markets, utility tariffs, and building or industrial energy management.
  • Experience with implementation of APIs from internal and external sources.
  • Experience with GHG accounting (Scopes 1,2 and 3), energy benchmarking, and sustainability reporting frameworks.
  • Proven experience establishing, implementing, and enforcing data quality standards with peers and teams outside your own.
  • Strong quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and develop actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting findings to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree or professional certifications (e.g., CEM, CMVP, PMP, GHG Management Certificate).
  • Experience with SaaS-based ESG data management systems & administration, energy modeling software, and/or LCA tools.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and voluntary reporting programs (CDP, ISSB, CSRD, utility efficiency programs, EPEAT).
  • Experience managing enterprise data systems, ETL pipelines, or energy management software.

Skills

  • Analytical, detail‑oriented, and curious.
  • Proven critical thinking is a MUST for success in this role.
  • Enthusiastic, strong problem‑solver with a continuous improvement mindset.

Job Description:

The Proctor is responsible for the invigilation of tests and exams for students and applicants participating in a wide range of assessments at the Algonquin College Test Centre and the Centre for Accessible Learning (CAL) Test Services.

The incumbent ensures that testing takes place per Algonquin College policies, the policies and procedures of Testing Services, the specific test administration requirements outlined by the test provider or vendor, and all disability-related accommodations are put into place. The incumbent ensures the setup and troubleshooting of individual tests and exams are carried out each day.

Duties and responsibilities:

  • The incumbent is responsible for providing comprehensive service and support to all examinees registered to receive services through the Test Centre or CAL Test Services. The incumbent must explain and clarify policy and procedure regarding tests and exams, often referring students and staff to other resources;

  • The incumbent must know testing policies and procedures to assist students in requesting tests and testing accommodations. The incumbent receives tests/exams from faculty across the college and follows up with academic departmental representatives when the test is not provided or the faculty member has not dropped the test off on time;

  • The incumbent ensures test/exam accommodations are provided and students receive all testing materials, alternative formats and appropriate assistive technology and/or software;

  • The incumbent is responsible for maintaining a calm and respectful testing environment;

  • This individual will act as a reader and or scribe when required;

  • Ensures students with disabilities have access to Assistive Technology (Dragon Naturally Speaking, Read and Write, Natural Reader, Kurzweil, ZoomText, JAWS) and computer support for tests and exams as required;

  • Ensures the setup and troubleshooting of tests and exams being written on a computer;

  • The incumbent utilizes Net Control software to upload tests/exams from the Proctor workstation to monitor students writing computerized tests and exams;

  • Provides administrative support to the Test Services Team Lead and at times in the Centre for Accessible Learning;

  • Scans tests and exams for alternative formatting;

  • Ensures protocol is followed when receiving exams from faculty and pickup of tests/exams;

  • The incumbent responds to voicemail regarding general inquiries and cancellation of bookings;

  • The incumbent processes electronic grading of tests and exams.

  • Minimum two (2) year diploma or equivalent in Office Administration or related field of study;

  • Minimum two (2) years of experience in a Test Services facility in a post-secondary environment which includes the following:

    • Comprehensive experience in working with persons who have disabilities in an educational setting;

    • Work experience in a complex detail-oriented, customer service driven, computerized office setting;

    • Experience in Microsoft Office and/or certification in Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

    • Office experience with a client database such as Clockwork.

Duties/Expectations:

  • Teaching: The successful candidate will teach 4-5 regular classroom or laboratory courses (12-15 credit hours) per year in the ESS program, plus mentoring courses (approximately 50%). The teaching assignment will include an undergraduate environmental skills and certifications course designed to support students seeking professional environmental science jobs. Other assigned courses will depend on expertise and need but could include environmental science courses connected to the function of the EAL such as Soil Science with associated lab, Watershed Ecology, Environmental Policies and Laws, Quantitative Environmental Chemistry, or other courses focused on water, plant science, and/or environmental chemistry.
  • Managerial: Director of the BYU Environmental Analytical Lab (approximately 45%). The EAL is a core research facility of the College of Life Sciences under the direction of the Plant and Wildlife Sciences Department (PWS). The EAL performs chemical and physical testing of environmental samples (water, soils, sediments, plant or other organic tissues) for a diverse set of customers from inside and outside of BYU. The EAL is focused on student mentoring in a client-facing lab setting. Essential functions as the EAL director include:
  • Mentoring undergraduate students in the EAL, leading to tangible mentoring products such as student-led presentations at scientific meetings, abstracts, or papers.
  • Service on graduate committees in association with students who use the EAL to process samples related to their graduate research.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and quality control systems that ensure analyses are conducted efficiently and according to established scientific standards. Perform routine maintenance and safety checks on laboratory equipment and protocols.
  • Responsible for researching, evaluating, recommending, purchasing, and installing laboratory instrumentation and overseeing its operation, maintenance and repair.
  • Develop and administer laboratory budgets, with responsibility for balancing laboratory income with costs including wages, supplies, and equipment needs. Identify and pursue income and funding to support the mentoring goals of the lab.
  • Citizenship: Faculty are expected to participate actively in departmental, college, and university governance and engage in the intellectual and community life of the university (approximately 5%).

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.

As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.

We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.

Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.

What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Som medarbetare på boendeservice i Kungsberget är du en viktig del av ett sammansvetsat team som hjälper våra gäster med diverse problem som uppstår både i boendet och på anläggningen, till exempel om något saknas. title: HPC Software Engineer
description:
Requisition Id 16549

Overview:

We are hiring a HPC Software Engineer to design, operate and maintain clusters, servers, and workstations supporting services where science happens at ORNL! This position resides in the Emerging Technologies & Computing group in the Research Computing Division in the Information Technology Services Directorate at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).

The Emerging Technology Computational Group facilitates ORNL goals through HPC systems engineering, integration, and support for the research community at ORNL. By providing design, deployment, optimization, monitoring, and tooling support across multiple clustered infrastructures, we facilitate Lab-wide R&D projects. Our HPC clusters range in scope from just a handful of nodes to over fifty-thousand cores.

We partner with ORNL research organizations to enable research excellence and delivery. We work with other clustered computing and HPC groups to help research programs identify the best solutions for their needs. When we build our customer's environments, our team collaborates to design, implement, and maintain the systems from inception to retirement.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Advocate and promote HPC and clustered computing software solutions to researchers who process large data sets, run simulations, and develop scientific code as part of their projects.
  • Design, develop, optimize, and maintain scientific software, workflows, libraries, and tools for production HPC environments.
  • Ensure the performance, scalability, portability, reliability, and maintainability of software running on production systems.
  • Leverage automation, testing, and modern software engineering practices to minimize maintenance overhead and improve software quality and reproducibility.
  • Collaborate with technical points of contact and research teams to install, port, optimize, benchmark, and tune scientific applications and toolsets.
  • Support software environments for a wide range of computational workflows, including parallel and distributed applications, data-intensive pipelines, and accelerator-enabled workloads.
  • Work closely with system administrators, infrastructure engineers, and researchers to align software solutions with available compute, storage, and networking resources.
  • Contribute to CI/CD practices, software packaging, documentation, and sustainable development workflows for research computing environments.
  • Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, information systems, science, engineering, business, or a related discipline and a minimum of 5 years of aligned professional experience is required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • 3 or more years with managing UNIX/Linux Systems.
  • 3 or more years of proven experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Git, Jenkins, Ansible, or Puppet.
  • Moderate proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Bash, Python, or others.
  • Experience performing advanced troubleshooting and system administration with Linux Servers.
  • Experience supporting large data systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A strong desire to innovate and identify new technologies and opportunities and be able to communicate the potential benefits of those choices to others within the team and our research partners.
  • A collaborative and upbeat approach to thrive on the opportunity to build trust and credibility and ultimately become a trusted advisor to our research teams.
  • Active DOE Q, active DOD Top Secret, or active DOD TS/SCI clearance is heavily preferred for consideration.
  • Solid understanding of multiple operating systems and cluster technologies.
  • Experience with Rocky/Centos/RHEL, Ubuntu, VMware.
  • Understanding of HPC platforms to support users with SLURM job submissions and troubleshooting.
  • Experience building and running containerized applications in an HPC environment.
  • Experience with multiple deployment mechanisms like Diskless, Warewulf, and traditional deployment (cobbler, PXEboot, and/or Bright).
  • Experience managing systems utilizing GPU (NVIDIA and AMD) clusters for AI/ML and/or image processing.
  • Experience with performance and diagnostic tools for benchmarking, analysis and tuning of systems, networking, and storage.
  • Experience with Grafana, CheckMK, Nagios, Zabbix, or other network and device monitoring systems.
  • Experience with scientific software such as Matlab, R, Ansys, etc.
  • Experience with cluster administrative tools as Spack, Ansible, Git, etc.
  • Previous experience working in a government, scientific or other highly technical environment.
  • Good documentation skills, including ability to prepare simple documentation web pages.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and to participate creatively in collaborative teams across the laboratory.
  • Ability to function well in a fast-paced research environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to ever changing needs.

Special Requirements:

  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program.

About ORNL:

As a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Science national laboratory, ORNL has an impressive 80-year legacy of addressing the nation’s most pressing challenges. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

If you have trouble applying for a position, please email [email protected].

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply. UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

title: Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer
description:
Requisition ID 66103
Position Type FT Permanent
Workplace Arrangement

About the role

We have a fantastic opportunity for Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer with an electrical bias to join our Cam site, near Dursley in Gloucestershire.

Reporting directly to the Engineering Manager, the role of the Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer will be to support the Production team in delivering to its customers the highest quality product, on time and in full, by maintaining the plant & ensuring that all breakdowns are dealt with in a timely manner to minimise downtime.

As a Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer you will be the equipment owners and with an electrical bias take ownership of all systems & electrical applications. You will ensure that the plant fully complies with all safety legislation.and will be responsible for both proactive and reactive maintenance and repair of equipment, you will take ownership of follow on and improvement activities as required.

There will be an emphasis of minimising waste and downtime across the site, initiating RCA on significant failures.

The role requires strong communication skills, sharing information with all relevant parties (both skilled and unskilled) and recording all key information in SAP.

The role requires taking responsibility in assessing situations and required action before resorting to further escalation.

Working hours will be shift based with clearly defined ‘Production Focused’ and “Planned Maintenance Focused’ depending on Production and Maintenance requirements.

The shift pattern is an 8hr double days Mon – Fri 6-2 & 2-10 with the 3rd week on days 8-4 Wed – Sun & on call for that week.

We are very development focused so this is a fantastic opportunity for a successful engineer to further develop you engineering skills and knowledge, or progress further into technical or managerial roles.

About the Site

Located in Gloucestershire, the Cam site transforms natural Acacia Gum into high-quality powdered ingredients used in a wide range of food and beverage applications worldwide. As part of Kerry's global network, the site plays an important role in delivering innovative ingredients to customers across the food industry.

Our site combines a long and successful manufacturing heritage with a highly reliable production operation. Strong asset performance and low downtime reflect the dedication of our Engineering and Production teams, who work closely together to maintain high standards of safety, quality, and efficiency.

Engineering is at the heart of our success, with a strong focus on continuous improvement, reliability enhancement, and investment in our people and equipment. This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative team where your ideas, technical expertise, and problem-solving skills will make a real impact on site performance and future development.

With a strong track record of operational reliability and a culture built around teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement, the site offers engineers the opportunity to work in a varied process manufacturing environment with a wide range of equipment and technologies.

As a Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer, you'll play a key role in maintaining and improving our plant performance, driving reliability improvements, supporting exciting engineering projects, and helping to shape the future of the site. If you enjoy solving problems, developing your skills, and making a tangible difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

What will you be doing

When Production Focused - The role is expected to be predominantly based on the line during production hours, undertaking reactive maintenance, supporting changeovers, attending daily meetings and supporting production when required. Direction on production priorities will be given by the unit Front Line Manager.

When Planned Maintenance focused – the role is expected to be based within engineering undertaking planned maintenance, attending the daily engineering meeting, working closely with stores function and Maintenance Planner. Whilst Planned Maintenance focused the role may also support the Production as backup for the Production Focused engineer.

You will be competent in both mechanical and electrical systems, able to diagnose and resolve simple and complex breakdowns.

What can you bring to the role

  • Electrical Engineering Apprenticeship or equivalent.
  • Multi-skilled / cross-skilled capability
  • Minimum NVQ level 3
  • BTEC ONC / City and Guilds or equivalent in engineering discipline
  • Aptitude for process awareness,
  • Strong diagnostic / trouble-shooting experience gained in a Hi-volume manufacturing or process environment
  • Strong knowledge & experience of manufacturing electro/mechanical automated equipment & processes including pneumatic, hydraulic and instrumentation-controlled systems.
  • Proficient with Computers
  • Familiar with Computerised Maintenance Management Systems SAP
  • 5yrs manufacturing, packaging and processing experiences. Food industry experience would be a bonus.
  • PLC programming or diagnostics would be a bonus
  • Knowledge & experience with facilities plant, Boilers (steam or Hot water), refrigeration, air handling, effluent treatments plants.

In Kerry we know that sometimes the perfect candidate doesn’t exist, and people can be put off applying for a role if they don’t fit all the requirements. If you are excited about working for us and have the majority of the skills or experience, then please do apply as you could be exactly what we are looking for.

Why join Kerry?

In return we can offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package as well as the opportunity for self-growth and career development within one of the world’s leading manufacturers of food and nutrition technology. The package includes
Competitive salary, shift allowace and on call allowance.

  • Pension matched up to 10%
  • Life Assurance 6 x Salary (offered with the pension)
  • Share purchase scheme
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Emplyee Benefits platform
  • Volunteer Day

title: Analyst/Associate, Venture Creation
description:
Who we are:

Diagram is a venture builder and early-stage investor that conceives, launches, and invests in transformative companies in the Fintech and ClimateTech sectors. Since 2016, we’ve raised over $400M and launched or invested in more than 35 companies.

We work hand-in-hand with experienced founders, combining access to capital, hands-on support, and a deep ecosystem of partners to launch and scale businesses. Our ecosystem includes 200+ investors, including 60+ entrepreneurs with exits exceeding $15B, as well as a global network of corporate partners.

Diagram is part of Sagard, a global multi-strategy alternative investment platform with over US$40B in AUM

What we are looking for:

We are looking for an Analyst or Associate, Venture Creation to help launch new Diagram ventures, reporting to Diagram’s ClimateTech Venture Creation Principal.

The successful candidate will bring a highly entrepreneurial mindset and strong desire to build the next generation of technology companies.

This person will work directly with Diagram Partners, potential founders and expert advisors to lead the development, evaluation, de-risking and building of new ClimateTech ventures. The individual will play a key role in turning ideas into companies, and shaping Diagram’s portfolio.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing in-depth investment theses and perspectives on opportunity areas;
  • Generating and pitching new venture ideas;
  • Conducting user and market research, performing market sizing, analyzing competitive landscape, assessing business models and unit economics to evaluate potential ideas;
  • Developing pitch decks and investment memos;
  • Owning the work plan and leading the venture during pre-seed (E.g., securing pilot customers, building MVP in collaboration with engineering and other experts, leading partnerships with early design partners);
  • Pitching ideas to potential founders, participating in the vetting and team x idea matching process, and building close relationships with founders
  • Contributing to building Diagram's culture and brand in the community (e.g. attending startup community events, conferences, etc)

You should have:

  • A track record of outstanding performance
  • A proven entrepreneurial mindset, high degree of ownership and a self-starter mentality
  • 1-3 years of work experience in relevant fields such as:
    • Early stage venture capital investing (Seed or Series A)
    • Early-stage tech incl. product management, design-thinking / human-centered design, engineering, or other experience within tech startups
    • Consulting or advisory focused on tech products / businesses
    • Venture building at a venture studio
  • Intellectual curiosity and rigor
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - be comfortable pitching ideas, and be able to produce high-quality deliverables
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to build financial models, conduct market sizing
  • Familiarity and curiosity around leveraging emerging AI technologies to assist in decarbonising or improving climate resilience
  • A technical (Engineering, Computer Science, Economics) or business degree
  • Knowledge, experience or network in Sustainability & ClimateTech are a plus

What we offer:

  • A unique opportunity to learn how to build a VC-backed company 0-1;
  • An essential role in something big, meaningful and different;
  • The opportunity to push yourself, have ownership and impact;
  • A team of accomplished, ambitious and supportive individuals that will help you grow;
  • An ecosystem with many stretch opportunities including the potential to join a Diagram portfolio company;
  • Competitive compensation, including upside in the companies Diagram creates;
  • Beautiful offices in great locations (Montreal, Toronto);
  • Generous benefits for you and your family.


How to apply:

In order to be considered for the role, please apply to the role and attach:

  • Your resume, along with one thematic analysis - show us an example of how YOU think like a founder/entrepreneur by sharing with us an area you see opportunities for innovation.
    • You can attach these as one document in the resume field of the application process

Guidance for the thematic idea: Create a max 2 page memo or 4-8 slide presentation around a ClimateTech theme of your choice, addressing the following questions:

  • Pain Points: What are big problems to be solved in the theme?
  • Market Timing: What makes this area ripe for disruption today? What are the market headwinds and/or tailwinds?
  • Market Sizing: How big is the market today? What’s the market size projected in 2040?
  • Competition: Who are a few venture backed companies in the space?
  • Interesting Angles: What are a few ideas you’d be interested in exploring?

We are less interested in exhaustive research and more interested in how you think. Approach this as if you are pitching a new venture theme internally at Diagram. We’re looking for sharp insight, strong judgment, and clear venture angles - not a consulting-style industry report.

We encourage you to focus on a clearly defined theme within ClimateTech rather than covering the sector broadly. For example, instead of writing about “AI in Climate,” you might explore a focused theme such as agentic energy management in buildings. Depth within a well-defined wedge is stronger than a high-level overview of an entire category.

Note: we will select the top applicants to present their thematic analysis to us. Interviews will start following the close of applications.

-

Qui nous sommes :

Diagram est un constructeur de ventures et un investisseur en phase initiale qui conçoit, lance et investit dans des entreprises transformatrices dans les secteurs de la Fintech et de la ClimateTech. Depuis 2016, nous avons amassé plus de 400 M$ et lancé ou investi dans plus de 35 entreprises.

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des fondateurs expérimentés, en combinant l'accès au capital, un soutien pratique et un écosystème profond de partenaires pour lancer et développer des entreprises. Notre écosystème compte plus de 200 investisseurs, dont plus de 60 entrepreneurs ayant réalisé des sorties dépassant 15 G$, ainsi qu'un réseau mondial de partenaires corporatifs.

Diagram fait partie de Sagard, une plateforme mondiale d'investissement alternatif multi-stratégies avec plus de 40 G$ US en actifs sous gestion.

Ce que nous recherchons :

Nous recherchons un Analyste ou un Associé, Création de ventures pour aider au lancement de nouvelles ventures Diagram, rapportant au Principal, Création de ventures ClimateTech de Diagram.

Le candidat retenu apportera une mentalité entrepreneuriale très développée et un désir marqué de construire la prochaine génération d'entreprises technologiques.

Cette personne travaillera directement avec les Partenaires de Diagram, les fondateurs potentiels et les conseillers experts pour diriger le développement, l'évaluation, la réduction des risques et la construction de nouvelles ventures ClimateTech. L'individu jouera un rôle clé dans la transformation d'idées en entreprises et contribuera à façonner le portefeuille de Diagram.


Vos responsabilités comprendront :

  • Développer des thèses d'investissement approfondies et des perspectives sur les domaines d'opportunité;
  • Générer et pitcher de nouvelles idées de ventures;
  • Mener de la recherche utilisateur et marché, effectuer un dimensionnement de marché, analyser le paysage concurrentiel, évaluer les modèles d'affaires et l'économie unitaire pour évaluer les idées potentielles;
  • Développer des pitch decks et des mémos d'investissement;
  • Diriger le plan de travail et la venture durant la phase de pré-seed (p. ex., sécuriser des clients pilotes, construire un MVP en collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie et d'autres experts, diriger les partenariats avec les premiers partenaires de conception);
  • Pitcher des idées aux fondateurs potentiels, participer au processus de vérification et d'appariement fondateur x idée, et développer des relations étroites avec les fondateurs;
  • Contribuer à la construction de la culture et de la marque de Diagram au sein de la communauté (p. ex., assister à des événements de la communauté de startups, des conférences, etc.).


Vous devriez avoir :

  • Un bilan de performance exceptionnelle;
  • Une mentalité entrepreneuriale éprouvée, un haut degré de responsabilité et un esprit d'initiative;
  • 1 à 3 années d'expérience de travail dans des domaines pertinents tels que :
    • Investissement en capital-risque en phase initiale (Seed ou Série A);
    • Technologie en phase initiale incluant la gestion de produits, la conception centrée sur l'humain, l'ingénierie ou d'autres expériences au sein de startups technologiques;
    • Conseil ou services-conseils axés sur les produits ou les entreprises technologiques;
    • Venture building dans un studio de ventures;
  • Curiosité intellectuelle et rigueur;
  • Fortes compétences en communication (verbales et écrites) - à l'aise pour pitcher des idées et capable de produire des livrables de haute qualité;
  • Excellentes compétences analytiques et capacité à construire des modèles financiers et à effectuer un dimensionnement de marché;
  • Familiarité et curiosité envers l'utilisation des technologies émergentes en IA pour aider à la décarbonisation ou à l'amélioration de la résilience climatique;
  • Un diplôme en discipline technique (Ingénierie, Informatique, Économie) ou en affaires;
  • Les connaissances, l'expérience ou le réseau dans le domaine de la Durabilité et de la ClimateTech sont un atout.


Ce que nous offrons :

  • Une occasion unique d'apprendre comment construire une entreprise appuyée par du capital-risque de 0 à 1;
  • Un rôle essentiel dans quelque chose de grand, significatif et différent;
  • La possibilité de vous dépasser, d'avoir de la responsabilité et de l'impact;
  • Une équipe de professionnels accomplis, ambitieux et soutenants qui vous aideront à progresser;
  • Un écosystème avec de nombreuses opportunités de développement, incluant le potentiel de vous joindre à une entreprise du portefeuille de Diagram;
  • Une rémunération concurrentielle, incluant une participation aux gains des entreprises que Diagram crée;
  • De beaux bureaux dans des emplacements attrayants (Montréal, Toronto);
  • Des avantages généreux pour vous et votre famille.


Comment postuler :

Afin d'être considéré pour ce poste, veuillez postuler et joindre :

  • Votre CV, accompagné d'une analyse thématique - montrez-nous un exemple de votre réflexion d'entrepreneur/fondateur en nous partageant un domaine où vous voyez des opportunités d'innovation.
    • Vous pouvez joindre ces deux éléments comme un seul document dans le champ CV du processus de candidature


Directives pour l'analyse thématique : Créez un mémorandum de 2 pages maximum ou une présentation de 4 à 8 diapositives autour d'un thème ClimateTech de votre choix, en répondant aux questions suivantes :

  • Enjeux clés : Quels sont les grands problèmes à résoudre dans ce domaine ?
  • Opportunité de marché : Qu'est-ce qui rend ce secteur propice à la disruption aujourd'hui ? Quels sont les vents contraires et/ou favorables du marché ?
  • Dimensionnement du marché : Quelle est la taille du marché aujourd'hui ? Quelle est la projection de la taille du marché en 2040 ?
  • Concurrence : Quelles sont quelques entreprises financées par du capital-risque dans ce secteur ?
  • Angles intéressants : Quels sont quelques domaines que vous aimeriez explorer ?

Nous nous intéressons moins à la recherche exhaustive qu'à votre réflexion. Abordez cela comme si vous présentiez un nouveau thème de venture en interne chez Diagram. Nous recherchons une analyse perspicace, un jugement solide et des angles de venture clairs, pas un rapport de style consulting.

Nous vous encourageons à vous concentrer sur un thème bien défini au sein du ClimateTech plutôt que de couvrir le secteur dans son ensemble. Par exemple, au lieu d'écrire sur "l'IA dans le climat", vous pourriez explorer un thème ciblé comme la gestion énergétique autonome dans les bâtiments. La profondeur au sein d'un secteur bien défini est plus forte qu'un aperçu général de toute une catégorie.

Note : nous sélectionnerons les meilleurs candidats pour nous présenter leur analyse thématique. Les entretiens commenceront après la clôture des candidatures.

description:
Title:

Metrology Technician II -Tempe Swing Shift

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

Program Summary

KBR Metrology supports Honeywell Aerospace, Otto Instruments, Garrett Advance Motion, and their suppliers with services including onsite/offsite laboratory visits, test equipment calibration and repair, AMS2750 pyrometry services, metrology engineering, and equipment inspection. They also offer preventative maintenance, equipment sourcing, CMM inspections, automation and programming, measurement technical support, calibration recall system management, and performance tracking dashboards.

Job Summary

Metrology Technician II will provide day to day support for the Metrology Program Calibrating IMTE and guiding workflow with other technicians. Technician will be able to coordinate calibrations in house and out to vendors.

This position is for the swing shift: 2pm - 10pm.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Perform calibration and certification of electronic measuring and test equipment according to technical specifications, ensuring traceability to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).

  • Calibrate and repair equipment such as Multimeters, frequency counter, timers, oscilloscopes, pressure devices.

  • Calibrate standards used in calibrations and maintain equipment to established performance standards.

  • Record maintenance activities in CMS, generate reports on results of tests, conditions of equipment and/or systems, repairs, and preventive maintenance performed, and prepare necessary documentation as required by customer and regulatory requirements.

  • Utilize common laboratory measuring, calibrating, and test equipment.

  • Complete all other duties as assigned.

  • Utilize common laboratory measuring, calibrating, and test equipment.

  • Applies advanced skills in area of specialization.

  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma with 3+ years of experience in the field, OR associate’s degree in engineering technology or a relevant field with 3 years of experience.

  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following voltage, current, resistance, capacitance, time and frequency, signal conditioning, blueprint and drawings, dimensional tooling and hand tools, pressure controllers, pressure dead weight testers, force gages and load cells, etc.

  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office software, including Excel.

  • US citizenship is required for this role

  • Ability to work swing shift from 2pm - 10pm.

Preferred Qualifications

  • IndySoft, Fluke Met/Team, Fluke Met/Track and Met/Cal experience a plus+.

  • Proficient using Microsoft technology, including Excel

title: Mgr-Rooms Division I
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for the management and coordination of all Rooms area departments (including Front Office, Engineering/Maintenance and Housekeeping) and managing staff. Plans, develops, implements and evaluates the quality of property’s guest rooms. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance of the department. Ensures that standards and procedures are being followed. Leads specific team while assisting with meeting or exceeding property goals. The position ensures that the Rooms division meet the brand’s standards, targets customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Supporting the Management of Rooms Division Activities

• Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery.

• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

• Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

• Monitors and promotes room rates, specials, and promotions at the residence.

• Monitors expected arrivals and departures.

• Coordinates and makes preparations for group activities.

• Runs and reviews critical information contained in Rooms division reports.

• Operates all department equipment as necessary and reporting malfunctions.

• Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.

• Understands night audit procedures and being able to comprehend and utilize reports as necessary.

• Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

• Assists in ensuring the property’s crisis management plan is followed as applicable.

Managing Profitability

• Analyzes service issues and identifies trends.

• Works with Rooms division teams to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.

• Reviews and audits expenses.

Managing Revenue Goals

• Monitors Rooms division sales performance against budget.

• Reviews reports and financial statements to determine Rooms division performance against budget.

• Reviews Rooms division occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.

• Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holding team accountable for results.

Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.

• Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.

• Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

• Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.

• Creates an atmosphere in the Rooms division that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.

• Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

• Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

• Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.

• Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.

• Ensures that employees understand expectations and parameters for Room division duties.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.

• Interviews applicants as needed.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

• Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in the Rooms division (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings).

• Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee engagement results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

• Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

• Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.

description:
Join to apply for the Software Engineer III, Backend role at Tinder

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This range is provided by Tinder. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$160,000.00/yr - $180,000.00/yr

Our Mission

Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™.

Our Values

One Team, One Dream – We work hand-in-hand, building Tinder for our members. We succeed together when we work collaboratively across functions, teams, and time zones, and think outside the box to achieve our company vision and mission.

Own It – We take accountability and strive to make a positive impact in all aspects of our business, through ownership, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.

Never Stop Learning – We cultivate a culture where it’s safe to take risks. We seek out input, share honest feedback, celebrate our wins, and learn from our mistakes in order to continue improving.

Spark Solutions – We’re problem solvers, focusing on how to best move forward when faced with obstacles. We don’t dwell on the past or on the issues at hand, but instead look at how to stay agile and overcome hurdles to achieve our goals.

Embrace Our Differences – We are intentional about building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members. By leveraging different perspectives and other ways of thinking, we build better experiences for our members and our team.

The Engineering team is responsible for building innovative features and resilient systems that bring people together. We're always experimenting with new features to engage with our members. Although we are a high-scale tech company, the member-to-engineer ratio is very high—making the level of impact each engineer gets to have at Tinder enormous.

As a Backend Engineer at Tinder, you will have an outsized impact and ownership of the most visible aspects of the Tinder App. We are deeply invested in challenging norms, constantly improving architecture design, exploring emergent tech and ideas, and leveraging new technologies in interesting ways to deliver an app that is widely known the world over.

In this role you will:

  • Design, develop and operate scalable and resilient distributed services that run on Kubernetes or ECS
  • Collaborate with various functional teams across Tinder on the expansion of our service platform
  • Influence the team roadmap and product development
  • Recruit, encourage, and develop other team members

You’ll need:

  • Excellent knowledge and experience with a backend language like Java, Node.js, Go, C++
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or an equivalent field with 2+ years of industry work experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and coding
  • Strong designing and building distributed backend systems handling high volumes of traffic
  • Experience in handling ambiguous business requirements with excellent prioritization, time management abilities, and a focus on execution
  • Passion to tackle exciting engineering problems and make continuous improvements

Nice to have:

  • Experience with cloud computing systems such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience in design and development using NoSQL, such as DynamoDB or Cassandra
  • Experience with Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka, Spark, and Typescript
  • Agile development methodology and CI/CD
  • Experience with Docker containers

As a full‑time employee you will enjoy:

  • Flexible Vacation (with no waiting period), 10 annual Wellness Days
  • Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage
  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • 100% paid parental leave (including for non‑birthing parents) and family forming benefits
  • Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development
  • Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy
  • Free subscription to Tinder Gold

Commitment to Inclusion

At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer.
